author: Nightmare667
quote: A massive disappointment and an absolute technical mess. First off, releasing a flagship title in 2026 locked at 30 FPS with constant frame drops is completely unacceptable. On top of the terrible performance, the game is riddled with game-breaking bugs that make it practically unplayable. To make matters worse, there is no autosave feature—something that even years-old games like Subnautica or Assassin’s Creed consider a basic standard. Losing hours of progress because of a crash in a modern AAA game is a joke.Beyond the technical disaster, the gameplay and writing completely miss the mark. Instead of delivering a gritty, criminal empire-building experience, the game plays like a tedious life simulator. The story is weak, repetitive, and lacks any real **** worst part of the narrative is Jason’s pathetic, blind loyalty to Lucia. It is frustrating to watch him act like a doormat when everything in the story strongly hints that Lucia is cheating on him behind his back. Despite the obvious red flags, the game forces you into this toxic dynamic and doesn't even give you the freedom to pursue romance options with other characters like **** a game with this much hype and development time, the end result feels restrictive, broken, and poorly written. Save your money.
